name: Shenji Grenadiers
headerMeta: Golden era · Ranged infantry · cannon · 315 leadership · Both (Season IX & Tyranny Season)
pitch: A grenade-delivery unit rather than a shooter — its whole value is one well-timed spell-2 throw into a blobbed enemy, not its rifles. It has no listed counters or answer of its own, so its main risk is simply being caught out of position before that throw lands.

doctrines.name: Anti-Heavy-Shield Doctrine
doctrines.note: +350 DMG vs heavy-shielded units like spearmen and Pavise Crossbowmen

doctrines.name: Extra Grenade Doctrine
doctrines.note: unit-unique — +1 grenade, enough for an additional volley

veterancy.label: Full Bot
veterancy.body: The only veterancy the guide gives for this unit.

battleRole.positioning: Keep it safe rather than shooting — firing the rifles directly is near useless, so hold it back and wait for the fight to blob up before committing the grenade. {1}
battleRole.tips: Some maps let you throw grenades high up onto a wall to surprise the enemy on the other side. {1} Preferable to run two Shenji together — stacked nade volleys can wipe a blobbed fight outright. {1}

cards.name: Blue-tier archer (165 leadership)
cards.why: shown making Shenji Grenadiers (and Iron Reapers/Glaive heroes) completely useless against it, in a clip from a different unit's guide

controls.notes: The loop is a single input: spell 2 fires the grenade. {1}

gaps: No 'Counters' (Loses to / Struggles vs / This unit counters) section in the source guide.
No dedicated 'Tips & Tricks' section beyond the playstyle notes captured above.
